purpose: Non-profit scientific investigation and independently implemented behavioral reconstruction of Cubase for macOS, directed with morluto/rea.

target.selection_reason: Current build on the official download page at study start, broadest edition, matching operation manual, publicly accessible macOS installer.
target.other_architecture_status: Inventory first; x86_64/Rosetta behavior is a separate configuration.
target.edition_note: The official page describes a single installer for all editions; the license selects the running edition. Bundle inspection alone does not verify Pro functionality.
target.acquisition_scope: Complete official installer and native package extraction; full application static signature verification and separate eight VST3 checks complete. No installation or target execution.
target.integrity_evidence: Independent 69-segment and whole-image hashes; native DMG checksum; 49 XAR data checksums and 11 gzip streams; native package signature/notary observation; strict/deep/all-architectures app and eight VST3 verification. No independent fresh online revocation check.

host.limitation: Local macOS 27 is outside the published support list. Runtime observations here do not establish behavior on a supported configuration.

tooling.native_provider_verification_scope: Scoped doctor healthy; synthetic ARM64 controls plus actual Cubase component function dossiers. Retained findings distinguish synthetic readiness from target static evidence; no target execution.
tooling.rea_mcp_registration: Project-local CLI and persistent stdio MCP sessions; no global client registration.

evidence_classes.documented: A primary source says this; not measured in the target.
evidence_classes.static_observation: Exact artifact bytes, structures, instructions, or references, with digest and location.
evidence_classes.runtime_observation: A reproducible action on the identified target/configuration and its retained output.
evidence_classes.inference: A proposed explanation connecting observations; alternatives and disconfirming probes required.
evidence_classes.synthetic_control: An instrument test using our own data or executable; not Cubase evidence.
evidence_classes.candidate_conformance: An independently implemented candidate matches named reference cases under declared criteria.

acceptance.claim_unit: Named observable behavior under a fully identified configuration, stimulus and state history.
acceptance.promotion_rule: Require repeatable reference evidence, independent candidate output, negative controls, held-out compound scenarios and retained failures. Neither decompilation nor harness success establishes Cubase fidelity.

Bounded CPR clock recovery retains ordered audio tracks, shared native fixed clocks or one/two-point canonical jump maps, and concordant origin meter. Six pinned factory maps recover original period/anchor bits; four fixed results remain unchanged. V1/V2 interpreters and original CPR/report provenance are preserved. Active native descriptors must match exact source replay. Unknown source state remains unsupported; effective hosted clock equivalence is unverified.
Explicit native-to-application timing conversion retains musical anchors; untouched signature edits retain native timing. Persistence binds active clock provenance to the replayed preserved source.
Source-backed unresolved CPR audio events, bounded saved LoFi placement, explicit unplaced Classic event, shared object caches, source-replay provenance, Undo/Redo and playback/export barriers.

Explicit source-bound PCM attachment/replacement with whole-shared-file interval validation, transactional cleanup, SHA custody, Undo/Redo and package persistence; integer segment mapping integrated into actual-media validation.

Explicit source-event research rendering replays frozen CPR provenance and reconstructs one supported zero-origin event from user-selected matching mono/stereo PCM24 WAV, at the original rate, to Float32 WAV with a separate event-gain multiply. Fresh source state, no external pitch context, empty event processing state, supported hitpoint children, absent warp/inversion/explicit fades and source-effective automatic-fade flags zero are required. The event remains unresolved for ordinary project playback, mixdown and exchange; no frozen import profile or original/report is rewritten.
Fresh source-audio inspection decodes project/track automatic-fade settings, displays source gain/inversion/fade/warp state and uses a source-bound asynchronous save flow.

A checked native-derived rate-request budget kernel evaluates explicit conditional arithmetic, including initial mode-2 allowance, against 244 pinned analytical vectors and independent controls. It neither selects/certifies an available backend nor generates resampled samples.

Explicit source-preserving stereo event audition reuses verified source PCM at its saved rate, with Play/Pause/seek/end handling, a persistent event-only label and Exit action. Every resume/seek rereads source/report/media proof; project edits, replacement, attachment changes, Undo/Redo and changed selection end the mode. Project mixer, routing, effects and automation are bypassed. The unresolved event and frozen profiles remain unchanged; ordinary project playback, mixdown and exchange retain their barriers.

A bounded unit-agnostic reconstruction of native segment selection retains generation/successor behavior and inclusive endpoint comparison. Source audition supplies a separately justified zero-origin source descriptor; it does not infer arbitrary native builder units. Application scheduling uses its own half-open sample intervals and nearest-frame, ties-away-from-zero quantization. Device scheduling, unity routing and completion via AVAudioPlayerNode dataPlayedBack callbacks are application implementation, not measured Cubase host behavior.

Explicit native mode 0 Float 32 stereo conversion now supports both higher and lower integral project rates from 8–192kHz for eligible source events. The original-rate path stays the default, and equal-rate mode 0 remains unavailable because the captured equal-rate branch is not a transparent copy. Downsampling retains the native small/large-ratio branches, pending state, fused operation order and ignored flush behavior. The application explicitly selects disjoint output-after-input layout in one arena and an 8192-input partition rule that uses 8191+2 instead of 8192+1 at a final singleton. Source layout and partitions can change native samples/counts; they are application choices, not inferred hosted defaults. No lookahead or EOF padding is invented. For 1,058,400 input frames at 44.1kHz, that policy yields 767,967 frames at 32kHz and 384,000 at 16kHz.

Recovered stereo ring producer/consumer value operations transfer interleaved samples to two 32768-frame planes without gain. Application admission replaces native polling with transactional WOULD_BLOCK; the adapter writes and consumes at most 8192 output frames per transfer, including converter blocks larger than the ring. Normal underrun holds the native-style timeline, draining underrun copies a prefix and pads, and stopped output pads without consuming. The application uses only the sufficient-data branch for prepared output transfer.

Verified source PCM remains immutable and resident. A serial worker owns bounded conversion and four-buffer queue refill; player completions enqueue work and cancellation is serialized before stop/detach. Initial priming and seek preroll remain synchronous. Ring transfers are at most 8192 output frames. Application partition, queue and AVAudioEngine delivery policies are explicit; worker refill removes main-actor dependence but does not prove hard realtime deadlines, absence of all underruns or disk streaming. The UI playhead remains host-time based.

Explicit SoXR mode 2 source-event audition reconstructs the bounded native Float32 wrapper around a pinned public SoXR 0.1.3 build. It retains rounded request/drift arithmetic, initial zero storage and discard, partial backend consumption/production, input/output compaction, last-frame padding for positive EOF, zero padding for NULL EOF and one conditional final drain. Requested wrapper counts remain distinct from backend-produced counts. Mono/stereo kernel controls cover integral 8–192 kHz rates; the application admits stereo higher/lower/equal project rates in 8192-source-frame blocks, with last positive block final. Gain remains after conversion; ring transfer, fresh source proof and reset/preroll seeks are preserved. Original-rate audition remains the default and mode 0 remains an explicit research option. Native-mode 2 here identifies a reconstructed wrapper with public source, not binary/sample equivalence to bundled SoXR or an observed Cubase runtime/default selection.

Explicit native mode 1 source-event audition supports higher, lower and equal integral project rates from 8–192 kHz. The reconstructed mono/stereo Float32 kernel preserves the 32769-entry coefficient/difference tables, beta bits for 8.96, 128-double channel history, ordered coefficient/tap FMAs, phase/count progression, resize/reset and final-return trimming. The application uses stereo 8192-source-frame calls with the last positive block final, then event gain and ring transfer. Fresh cursors and source-origin preroll avoid treating native metadata-only reset as cleared history. Short first blocks can change samples; no arbitrary partition invariance is claimed. Host libSystem sin/sqrt supply the traced transcendental primitives, without asserting the proprietary runtime produces identical values.

Concrete static ownership connects the audition producer to the VstOpTrack Float32 callback adapter. The candidate preserves the explicit fused biased offset, admission/window and prefix value operations, plus the first-plane terminal-sample poststage. Converted app buffers use only that poststage after ring transfer, with zero prefix/offset and Rebase buffer partitions. A nonzero subnormal sentinel selects alternating Float32 correction; an exponent-all-ones sentinel clears the block. Other samples are not independently scanned by the native rule. Supplied-state controls do not establish native transport state, scheduler topology or device equivalence.

An explicit source-rate native timeline-reader audition now uses absolute frame windows, the recovered narrowed-reciprocal/FMA quantizer, segment intersection, prefix/gap silence and exact source seeks. Its direct stereo memory reads apply event gain once and run through the serial playback worker. It does not use the audition FIFO or a generic resampler. Real CPR admission retains the verified single zero-origin source-event contract. Synthetic placed/adjacent/gapped descriptors test the reader but do not establish nonzero CPR construction or full-project playback.

Native timeline audition now reconstructs supported nonzero saved event starts, whole-frame trims and source offsets through the source clock and clip datum, then the separate native builder and reader rounding stages. Full media capacity is validated independently of the event span. Source-backed derived CPR controls cover placements before, at and after the original 600-second tempo-map knot. Absolute timeline bounds extend to 24 hours without allocating leading silence. The inspector and audition timeline expose the ephemeral source range while frozen V4 imports stay unchanged. Saved track delay must be zero; fresh resource state without later host delay mutations and a source-rate builder context are explicit reconstruction choices. Differing-rate placed events, overlaps, fades, full channels and full-project playback remain unresolved. Existing zero-origin mode0/1/2 conversion remains separately tested and available.

Explicit native project-clock audition now plays supported placed/trimmed stereo PCM24 CPR events at the supplied Rebase clock while the retained source accessor stays at the file rate. Raw source frames are not resampled; saved clip-datum duration/offset and original tempo-clock start remain distinct from builder/reader frame coordinates. Differing clocks therefore change speed/pitch and raw seek/count. Full source capacity is required; positive-short-read windows are rejected before scheduling. Integral8k-192k rates, common builder/reader rate and factor1 are explicit application context, not recovered CPR project/device state. Old original-rate and explicit mode0/1/2 conversion paths remain separate. Ordinary whole-project playback remains gated.

Current CPR profile V5 decodes the explicit PArrangement-to-PArrangeSetup attachment and preserves raw Float32 base-rate and Double factor bits with source-object provenance. New imports use the saved rate only for an integral base from 10000 to 192000 Hz and exact +1 factor; missing, unknown or unsupported setup retains a labeled application default, never a native-rate claim. Frozen V1-V4 imports remain replayable without rewriting originals, reports or current projects. A separate saved-project-clock source-event mode freshly replays preserved setup and tempo independently of later Rebase rate or timing edits. Supplied-Rebase-clock and original-rate modes stay distinct; explicit mode 0/1/2 conversion is unchanged. The source accessor keeps its file rate and existing event, processing, provenance and full-capacity gates remain. This is bounded source-event audition, not complete native-track or project playback.

Local roundtrips/XSD checks are not Cubase runtime interoperability.
